text_block_list.text:
Having thought up a good training regimen, 
I was working with a calorie bar in hand 
when—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hey there. Just like Tazuna-san said, 
you're completely cooped up in the 
trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Your dedication is admirable, but do you 
really intend to get by on light snacks 
until you reach a stopping point?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I understand you're eager now that you see 
a glimmer of hope, but pushing yourself to 
illness defeats the whole purpose, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, it's lunch time, my 
friend! Restore your condition with some 
delicious food!

Her words and demeanor clearly show her 
consideration for me. How should I 
respond—
choice_data_list:
If anything, I'd rather get proper 
nutrition.

I'd really prefer to prioritize work right 
now, so...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Right? There's a great place nearby. 
Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Today is my treat. Eat your fill of 
whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Think of it as an investment in youth with 
a bright future. There's no need to hold 
back.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You remind me so much of myself that I 
just can't leave you be.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I tend to just slap together whatever for 
meals when I'm busy too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Like rice balls you can eat with one hand, 
or calorie barsââjust like you're 
doing right now.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Before long, "once in a while" turns 
into "frequently," and eventually becomes 
"always," you know?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Not that I'm one to talk, mind you. Once I 
get fired up, I end up prioritizing work 
before I know it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
However, while doing so, Yayoi... your 
academy's Chairwoman came by and—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
She tells me, "Being all work and no play 
won't do," and takes me out for a meal.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
She claimed it was just part of 
communicating, but she was likely looking 
out for me so I wouldn't collapse.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Inviting you was basically me imitating 
that. In short, completely borrowed 
material!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what a great smile! Yep, yep, we 
really are two of a kind after all!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to take meals for granted, but 
getting invited out by someone always 
feels nice.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
There are things you miss out on when 
eating alone! Come on, let's have a nice, 
fun lunch together today.

Afterward, we spent a wonderful time 
savoring delicious food together.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look at that enthusiasm! All right, 
if you know any good places, will you show 
me?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Oh, this place! Great choice.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I've been brought here a few times myself. 
They have a great variety of combo meals.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Every option is nutritionally balanced, 
and the salad bar has unlimited refills, 
which is super satisfying!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Now then, the question is what to order—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
If we're doing this, let's get the limited 
menu! Two Great Hamburg Steak sets, 
please!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Think of it as an investment in youth with 
a bright future. There's no need to hold 
back.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You remind me so much of myself that I 
just can't leave you be.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Like me, when you get engrossed in your 
work, you're the type to settle for quick 
meals you can eat with one hand, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I can take notes while eating, and I can 
check work updates on my smartphone too.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Still, it makes people worry when they 
watch. Yayoi――your Chairwoman―― scolds me 
about it all the time.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps your own trainee is worrying about 
the exact same thing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Our students watch us more closely than 
you'd think. Especially their own 
trainers.
choice_data_list: We really need to be careful...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
No need to look so grave. It's all about 
mindset, mindset!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to kick this habit 
either, you know. Though I do feel rather 
bad about it……

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
So it's really a big help when you join me 
for meals like this from time to time!

After that, we enjoyed a meal together, 
chatting about everyday things.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Looks crowded. Shall we try another 
place?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Urk, here too?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
To think that every single restaurant 
would be fully booked...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to check other shops 
now... Guess I'll just have to grab 
something at the convenience store on my 
way back.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry it turned out like this. To make 
it up to you, let me treat you at the 
convenience store.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Man, if Yayoi finds out, she's totally 
gonna lecture me...

I headed home alongside a wryly smiling 
Mei Satake.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Well, I get that there are times 
when you just want to run to your absolute 
limit.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yet, the sight of pushing oneself to the 
absolute limit can sometimes cause others 
distress—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no good, no good at all! I'm just 
lecturing you at this point.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate you saying so. Please let me 
invite you to a meal another time.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
One last thing. Just make sure you don't 
collapse out there, alright?

Watching her walk away, I felt truly 
grateful for her kindness.
